full_track.tags: K-Pop acoustic ballad. A bright, steel-string acoustic guitar plays a rhythmic, percussive strumming pattern with frequent palm mutes and syncopated accents. A clean electric bass follows the root notes of the guitar chords with a warm, rounded tone. The male lead vocal is a smooth tenor, utilizing a mix of chest voice and light head voice transitions. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the percussive guitar and the vocal melody. Key of E Major. Tempo is 92 BPM. 4/4 time signature.

[Intro]
[percussive acoustic guitar strumming, palm mutes]

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals enter]
덜커덩 덜커덩 리듬을 타고
마지막 칸에 앉으면 보여
선로가 두 갈래로 갈라지며
